title: Interview Like a PRO with CONFIDENCE
description:
In this class, we'll cover interviewing—which is probably the most important part of the whole job search process. Your resume's job is to get you in the door, but once you're there, you really need to prove yourself through the interview process, which is often times a long and multi-step process. 

We're going to talk about the tips and tricks that you can utilize to get the best out of the interview process. Here’s what we’ll touch on: 

1. Interview stages. Every company will do it slightly differently, but there are major stages that are relatively consistent across organizations, and we want you to know what's happening on the other side so you’re empowered and understand the process. 
2. How to research, both the company and the interviewer. 
3. Interviewing itself and a few different methodologies for how you would answer questions in particular, the CAR method and the STAR method.
4. Deep dive into video interviewing and doing interviews over Zoom, and some of the things you want to look out for there.
5. How to leverage your Work Style and how to style your interviewer so that, based on cues in the conversation, you can tailor your approach to quickly connect with the interviewer. 
6. The follow-up—probably one of the most important things that people overlook. We’ll touch on some of the techniques and give you some templates for how to follow up. 
7. A wrap-up on how we think about interviewing more broadly.

----------
00:00 | Introduction
01:47 | Approach | Your resume gets your in the door, interviewing gets you the offer
04:32 | Interview Stages (Major stages that are relatively consistent across organizations)
09:00 | How to research, both the company and the interviewer...
17:35 | Interviewing (Methodologies, the CAR method & the STAR method)
31:40 | Video Interviews (Preparation and testing)
42:39 | Styling Your Interviewer (and leveraging your work style)
55:04 | Following Up (Leave a good final impression)
58:21 | Wrapping up & conclusion


Let’s dive in. For more interview tips, visit tealhq.com.
